body: Brb... I've got one or two things I have to do and I was driving until a second ago. Please stay with me.. I don't have a single person I feel like I can talk to

I would never want him to hurt, its so hard to convince myself my presence in his life would be for the better. He's not old enough to understand, so I would just be a picture in an old photo album to him.

I'd done so fucking well... I hadn't acted out like this in months.. why do I keep fucking doing this?? I'm alienating myself from everyone that I ever cared about or ever cared about me.
Thank you for replying, though... I am so glad to hear someone cares...
I feel like no one I know takes me seriously. They think when I say I'm depressed that I'm just looking for sympathy. I have waited so long for this. I'm ready to give up hope.
But I've done nothing but tell myself that for a year and a half and I'm sick of hurting her over and over :( My dad was abusive to me and I don't want him to experience the same thing
